label: Basic Variants
description: Default, separator, and border markers. Best for the 3 variant shapes stacked with no icons: a plain line, a labeled divider and a line ruled underneath.

label: Tool Call Log
description: Tool call log with icon markers. Best for a bare column of 6 tool calls, each led by an icon for its action, with no card, status or grouping.

label: Run Status
description: Run status markers with a live step. Best for a titled run card mixing done, failed and in progress rows, with a failed badge and a spinner on the live step.

label: Phase Separators
description: Agent run log grouped by phase separators. Best for plan, Edit and Verify dividers splitting 8 icon steps in a run card that shows the run name and duration.

label: Changed Files
description: Changed files summary with border markers. Best for a diff of 5 files in ruled rows: truncated monospace paths, an added, modified or removed badge and a line delta.

label: Links & Action
description: Markers as links and as an action button. Best for a pair of link rows over a button row that flips between revert and undo, announcing the change.
